title: PPWR: What UK beauty manufacturers need to know about exporting to Europe
summary: With the rollout of the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR), UK beauty manufacturers exporting to Europe need to pay close attention to an often-overlooked part of the supply chain: transport packaging, writes CHEP’s Katie Ingham
